_comment: Copy to config.json beside the scripts, or to C:\ProgramData\EndpointHealth\config.json. Values here override the defaults in EndpointHealth.psm1. Anything you omit keeps its default. Command line parameters override this file.
_comment_FolderNameStyle: Compact gives HOST_9-17_1059. Sortable gives HOST_2026-09-17_1059, which sorts correctly in Explorer once you have runs from more than one month.
_comment_ToolsPath: Optional binaries. Drop Procmon64.exe here to enable the Procmon engine, and smartctl.exe to get per-attribute SMART data that Windows does not surface. Neither is required.

DeepCapture._comment: Fired only when a trigger holds. WPR is built into Windows and needs nothing deployed. Procmon needs Procmon64.exe in ToolsPath.
DeepCapture._comment_ProcmonConfig: Path to a .pmc filter config exported from the Procmon GUI with Drop Filtered Events enabled. Without one, a two minute capture on a busy machine is several hundred MB.

Triggers._comment: A trigger fires only after it has held for ConsecutiveSamples passes, so a single spike does not burn a capture slot. Loosen these if you are getting no captures; tighten them if you are getting six a day and none of them show the problem.

_comment_MaxLocalStageMB: Hard cap on staged data so a campaign that loses its share cannot fill the system drive. Oldest captures are pruned first; telemetry and the snapshot are never pruned.
_comment_RedactUserNames: Replaces the username segment in collected paths and process command lines. Consider enabling this if the share is visible to a wider audience than the people running the investigation.
